lines.en: label rindate50:
I tap on Rin’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Rin 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: I’m not sure if she’ll pick up or not following the recent episode in her dorm room, but even {i}I’m{/i} not horrible enough to just leave her hanging if she feels like shit.
lines.zh: 我不确定她会不会接——毕竟她宿舍房间里最近发生了那件事——但就算{i}我{/i}再混蛋，也不至于在她难受的时候就这么晾着她。

lines.en: I was there for Molly, wasn't I?
lines.zh: 我当时陪着 Molly 了，不是吗？

lines.en: Granted, I don’t really think I did anything to {i}help{/i} her...but {i}she’s{/i} still alive and, at least to my knowledge, not cutting herself.
lines.zh: 当然，我并不觉得自己真{i}帮{/i}上她什么忙……但{i}她{/i}还活着，而且至少据我所知，没有再自残。

lines.en: The phone rings for longer than normal.
lines.zh: 电话响得比平时久。

lines.en: I’m not sure if Rin is just one of those people who never bothered setting up a voicemail box, but at this point, I feel like I’d probably be better off-
lines.zh: 我不确定 Rin 是不是那种懒得设置语音信箱的人，但事到如今，我觉得我大概还不如——

lines.en: Well, nevermind then.
lines.zh: 好吧，那就当我没说。

lines.en: : Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin？

lines.en: I can hear breathing, so I know she’s there...but she’s sure taking her sweet ass time to say hello.
lines.zh: 我能听见呼吸声，所以我知道她在……可她慢吞吞地就是不肯打招呼。

lines.en: : I know you’re there, you know. I can hear you.
lines.zh: : 我知道你在，你知道吗。我能听见你。

lines.en: : Hey.
I stop pacing around and lean up against the first wall I see to better focus on the conversation.
lines.zh: 我停下踱步，靠在我看到的第一面墙上，好更专心地听她说。

lines.en: I have a feeling it might be a rough one.
lines.zh: 我有预感，这通电话可能会很难熬。

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: : Are you...free right now, by any chance?
lines.zh: : 你……现在有空吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have called you if I wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 我要是没空就不会打给你了。

lines.en: : Do you think we could maybe...meet up or something?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……见个面什么的？

lines.en: : Like, somewhere private.
lines.zh: : 就是，找个没人的地方。

lines.en: : You don’t want to bring Futaba along?
lines.zh: : 你不想叫上 Futaba？

lines.en: : No...Not this time.
lines.zh: : 不……这次不想。

lines.en: : I kind of just want it to be you.
lines.zh: : 我只想见你一个人。

lines.en: : That’s...odd.
lines.zh: : 这……有点奇怪。

lines.en: : Why? Do you not want to?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你不想吗？

lines.en: : No, it’s just that you don’t normally ask to be alone with me when it doesn’t involve your feelings for a girl in some way or another.
lines.zh: : 不是，只是你平时要求跟我独处，多少都跟你对某个女孩子的感情有关。

lines.en: : Did something happen with Otoha?
lines.zh: : Otoha 那边出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : No, Otoha’s great. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 没有，Otoha 很好。只是……

lines.en: : It’s just not something I can talk to her about. And Futaba’s already worried sick, so...
lines.zh: : 只是这件事我没法跟她说。而且 Futaba 已经担心坏了，所以……

lines.en: : There’s always Molly.
lines.zh: : 你还有 Molly 啊。

lines.en: : Please, I’m asking for you.
lines.zh: : 拜托，我现在要的是你。

lines.en: : I want to see you.
lines.zh: : 我想见你。

lines.en: : Well then hurry up and tell me where to go. It’s not doing you any good just waiting wherever you are.
lines.zh: : 那就快点告诉我在哪儿。你干站在那儿等也不是办法。

lines.en: : Oh, where {i}are{/i} you by the way?
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，你{i}现在{/i}在哪儿？

lines.en: : Just in the dorm right now.
lines.zh: : 就在宿舍里。

lines.en: : I don’t really want anyone else to see us, so...is it okay if we hang out in some sketchy alley or something like that?
lines.zh: : 我不想让别人看到我们，所以……我们能不能去什么偏僻的小巷子里待着？

lines.en: : What a strange request.
lines.zh: : 这要求可真奇怪。

lines.en: : You’re not planning on taking advantage of me, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会打算占我便宜吧？

lines.en: : The only thing I’ll be taking advantage of is your................time.
lines.zh: : 我唯一要占的便宜，是你的……………………时间。

lines.en: : Get it? Because I paused for a-
lines.zh: : 懂了吗？因为我停顿了一下——

lines.en: : You’re not upset at all, are you?
lines.zh: : 你一点都不难过，是吧？

lines.en: : I have no idea what I am, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己到底是什么，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 我们很快就见。

lines.en: scene black
Rin hangs up the phone and sends me an address not far away from the creepy cathedral Yasu hangs out at.
lines.zh: Rin 挂了电话，给我发来一个地址，离 Yasu 常待的那座阴森大教堂不远。

lines.en: Great.
lines.zh: 好极了。

lines.en: I slide my phone into my pocket and figure that it’s just a coincidence and that Rin isn’t also just a religious cult member now...
lines.zh: 我把手机塞进口袋，告诉自己这只是巧合，Rin 应该没有也成了什么宗教邪教的成员……

lines.en: But, in the event that she starts trying to indoctrinate me next, I should be prepared.
lines.zh: 不过，万一她接下来要给我洗脑，我得有所准备。

lines.en: I slide a bullet into the chamber of my revolver and get ready to fight for what I love, which is...not loving anything.
lines.zh: 我往左轮手枪的弹巢里推了一发子弹，准备好为我所爱的东西而战——而我所爱的，正是……不去爱任何东西。

lines.en: Then, I wave my hand to remind myself that the revolver is imaginary and set out toward an area of Kumon-mi that’s almost as sketchy as the second half of town.
lines.zh: 然后我挥了挥手，提醒自己那把左轮手枪是想象出来的，动身前往 Kumon-mi 的一处地方，那里几乎和镇子的另一半一样可疑。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight1
: Umm...hey.
: Hey. You look like shit.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你看起来糟透了。

lines.en: : I feel like shit. But I think I’m getting close to the tail end of it.
lines.zh: : 我感觉也糟透了。不过我觉得自己差不多快熬到头了。

lines.en: : Did you...come all the way here without a jacket? Aren’t you cold?
lines.zh: : 你……一路过来都没穿外套？你不冷吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我不知道。

lines.en: : I left it at the dorm and didn’t feel like going back for it.
lines.zh: : 我把外套落在宿舍了，懒得回去拿。

lines.en: : So you just walked a few miles without it instead.
lines.zh: : 所以你就这么走了好几英里，也没穿。

lines.en: : Pretty much, yeah.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，对。

lines.en: : So, what’s the reason for this incredibly suspicious private meeting in the middle of nowhere?
lines.zh: : 那么，这场在荒郊野外进行的、可疑到极点的私密会面，到底是为了什么？

lines.en: : Venting, I guess? Taking my mind off of stuff.
lines.zh: : 发泄吧，大概？让我别再想那些事。

lines.en: : Probably just going to rattle off a bunch of stuff that’s been popping into my head and hope you can help with some of it because, weirdly enough, I really trust your judgement.
lines.zh: : 大概就是把我脑子里冒出来的东西一股脑倒出来，希望你能帮上点忙，因为说来奇怪，我真的很相信你的判断。

lines.en: : Well, that seems like a horrible idea on your end. My judgement is terrible.
lines.zh: : 嗯，从你这边来看，这似乎是个糟透了的决定。我的判断力很差劲。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight2
: It’s really not, though...
lines.zh: : 可它真的不差……

lines.en: : Like...you’ve never done anything messed up to me and we’ve been friends for a really long time now.
lines.zh: : 就是……你从来没对我做过什么过分的事，而我们已经是这么久的朋友了。

lines.en: : You even gave me a chance to confess to Chika before going after her...when you knew all along that you could have had her whenever you wanted.
lines.zh: : 你甚至在追 Chika 之前，先给了我向她表白的机会……而你一直都知道，你随时都能得到她。

lines.en: : I...really care about your advice. And I kind of need a lot of it right now.
lines.zh: : 我……真的很在意你的建议。而我现在非常需要它。

lines.en: : I’m starting to think I might be a bad influence on you if you’re coming to {i}me{/i} for advice.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得，如果你都来找{i}我{/i}出主意，那我大概对你是个坏影响。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight3
: Then just pretend I’m coming to you like you’re my counselor and not {i}Sensei{/i}.
lines.zh: : 那你就假装我是来找你这个咨询师的，不是来找 {i}Sensei{/i} 的。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t know this since you never show up for counseling, but I’m just as bad at that as I am at normal advice.
lines.zh: : 你不会知道的，因为你从来不出席咨询——可我在那方面的水平和平时给建议一样烂。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m probably even worse when the counselor mask is on.
lines.zh: : 事实上，戴上咨询师的面具之后，我大概更糟。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight4
: Well then I guess you {i}are{/i} a bad influence and...that you’re just rubbing off on me or something, because I have no idea who else to talk to about this, or...
lines.zh: : 那看来你还{i}真是{/i}个坏影响，而且……大概是传染给我了什么的，因为我实在不知道还能跟谁说这些，也……

lines.en: : Or how I’m even {i}going{/i} to talk about this because it’s all just circling around inside of my head like some...fucked up, broken washing machine.
lines.zh: : 也不知道该怎么{i}开口{/i}——因为这一切就在我脑子里转个不停，像一台……坏掉的、他妈的洗衣机。

lines.en: : Weird comparison, but I get it.
lines.zh: : 比喻挺怪，但我懂。

lines.en: : Before that, though, how is your arm?
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，你的胳膊怎么样了？

lines.en: scene rinhappynight5
: Sore.
: I obviously have to wear sweaters and stuff to cover everything up, but my sleeves keep sticking to the cuts as the scabs are forming.
lines.zh: : 我显然得穿长袖什么的把伤口遮住，可结痂的时候袖子老是粘在上面。

lines.en: : And every time I move my arm too quickly, it rips them off and reopens a few and it’s just rinse-repeat, rinse-repeat.
lines.zh: : 而且每次我胳膊动得太快，就会把痂扯掉，重新裂开几道，然后就是一遍又一遍，一遍又一遍。

lines.en: : It’s weird, cause like...when I’m doing it, I can barely even feel it. It’s always the days after that hurt the most.
lines.zh: : 奇怪的是，就是……我做那件事的时候，几乎感觉不到。最疼的永远是之后的几天。

lines.en: : Well, if you don’t mind me going on one of my famous depressing tangents-
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果你不介意我又开始发表那些著名的丧气话——

lines.en: scene rinhappynight6
: Ooh, I love those! They’re fun!
lines.zh: : 哦，我爱听那些！可有意思了！

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : But anyway, that feeling you described is essentially just how pain works as a whole.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，你刚才描述的那种感觉，基本上就是疼痛整体的运作方式。

lines.en: : Nothing is ever its worst as soon as it happens.
lines.zh: : 任何事在发生的当下都不会是最糟的。

lines.en: : The natural reaction to bad news or a traumatic injury is panic.
lines.zh: : 面对坏消息或创伤性的伤害时，人自然的反应是恐慌。

lines.en: : You don’t have time to really {i}think{/i} about what went down or...feel anything, because it’s all happening so fast.
lines.zh: : 你根本没有时间去{i}细想{/i}发生了什么，或者……去感受什么，因为一切都发生得太快了。

lines.en: : I’m sure whatever was going through your head at the time of...what you were doing to yourself is no exception to that.
lines.zh: : 我敢说，在你……对自己做那些事的时候，你脑子里闪过的东西也不例外。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight7
: I told you, though...there wasn’t {i}anything{/i} going through my head. That’s why it was all so weird.
lines.zh: : 可我说过了……当时我脑子里{i}什么都没有{/i}。所以才那么奇怪。

lines.en: : It’s like when the battery of your phone dies or something. An immediate switch from full of life to...complete blackness.
lines.zh: : 就像是手机没电了什么的。从充满生机一下子切换到……彻底的漆黑。

lines.en: : And the only thing that can bring it back to life is a surge of power.
lines.zh: : 而唯一能让它重新亮起来的，就是一股电流的冲击。

lines.en: : You don’t need to explain it or anything. I just don’t want you doing something that will not only put you in danger but ruin everything you finally have going for you.
lines.zh: : 你不用解释什么的。我只是不希望你去做什么——它不仅会让你陷入危险，还会毁掉你终于拥有的一切。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight2
: See, this is why I wanted to see you.
lines.zh: : 看吧，这就是我想见你的原因。

lines.en: : Futaba’s great, but she’s too sentimental when it comes to stuff like this. You’ll just give it to me straight.
lines.zh: : Futaba 很好，但在这种事上她太感性了。你会直接把话撂给我。

lines.en: : Call me a fucking idiot, Sensei. Do it.
lines.zh: : 骂我一句他妈的蠢货吧，Sensei。来啊。

lines.en: : Okay. You’re a fucking idiot.
lines.zh: : 好。你是个他妈的蠢货。

lines.en: : Now...tell me to beat this stupid depression’s...stupid face!
lines.zh: : 现在……叫我去揍这该死的抑郁的……该死的脸！

lines.en: : Beat your stupid depression’s face or whatever.
lines.zh: : 揍你那该死的抑郁的脸，或者什么的。

lines.en: : Now tell me you love me!
lines.zh: : 现在对我说你爱我！

lines.en: : No.
scene rinhappynight8
: Aww. Mean.
lines.zh: : 啊。好过分。

lines.en: : I love {i}you{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我爱{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Sorry, did I turn into Otoha overnight or something?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我是一夜之间变成 Otoha 了吗？

lines.en: scene rinhappynight6
: No, but if you ever do, please send nudes.
lines.zh: : 没有，不过你要是真变了，请发裸照。

lines.en: : I need them to hold me over as I endlessly fight off the undying need to tackle her and just...{i}ugh.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我需要它们撑着我，好让我无休止地抵抗那种想把她扑倒的不死冲动，然后……{i}唉{/i}。

lines.en: : Hang in there, Rin. I’m sure it’ll happen soon enough.
lines.zh: : 撑住，Rin。我相信那一天很快就会来的。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight7
: I know, I know...It’s just...
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道……只是……

lines.en: : You know what, come with me.
lines.zh: : 这样吧，跟我来。

lines.en: : I know nobody’s around because this part of town is dead, but I’d feel a little more...secretive if we weren’t in the middle of the sidewalk.
lines.zh: : 我知道这地方没人，因为这一带死气沉沉的，不过要是我们别站在人行道正中间，我会觉得更有……秘密感一点。

lines.en: scene black
Rin scurries off and, for a brief moment, her childish energy distracts me from the bags beneath her eyes.
lines.zh: Rin 小跑着走开，有那么一瞬间，她孩子气的活力让我暂时忽略了她眼下的黑眼圈。

lines.en: It takes a special type of person to wear a smile like that on a body covered in scars, and I’m reminded once more of why I took to Rin in the first place.
lines.zh: 要在一具布满伤疤的身体上挂出那样的笑容，需要一种特别的人，而我再一次想起自己当初为什么会喜欢上 Rin。

lines.en: She’s like a canvas that an artist accidentally spilled every one of his paints on.
lines.zh: 她就像一块画布，画家不小心把所有的颜料都洒在了上面。

lines.en: But instead of trashing it like anyone else would do, he started punching it and punching it, filling it with holes in the shape of a face that, if you look closely enough, resembles something we’ve all felt before.
lines.zh: 但他没有像别人那样把它扔掉，而是开始一拳又一拳地揍它，在上面砸出一个脸形的孔洞——如果你凑得够近，会发现那张脸像极了我们每个人都曾感受过的东西。

lines.en: The inherent desire to love and be loved, mixed with a tinge of self-doubt and so many hormones that one good stroke would do it in for the night.
lines.zh: 那种想要去爱、也想要被爱的本能欲望，掺杂着一丝自我怀疑，还有多到一记重击就能让人彻底瘫软的荷尔蒙。

lines.en: This is the person Rin is.
lines.zh: 这就是 Rin。

lines.en: A mixture of bad things and good things, held together with glue made from only the best of bodily fluids.
lines.zh: 坏的东西和好的东西混在一起，用只由最好的体液做成的胶水黏合起来。

lines.en: It’s a shame she still seems so far away from that last part, though.
lines.zh: 只可惜，她看起来离最后那一部分还很远。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight9
: Okay. This is {i}slightly{/i} better than out there in the open.
lines.zh: : 好。这比在外面开阔的地方{i}稍微{/i}好一点。

lines.en: : What was it that you couldn’t tell me twenty feet away from where we’re standing right now?
lines.zh: : 你有什么话，是站在二十英尺外不能告诉我的？

lines.en: : Just more stuff about Otoha, probably.
lines.zh: : 大概还是关于 Otoha 的事。

lines.en: : And how I’m worried I’m gonna snap and do something bad before she’s ready for it.
lines.zh: : 还有我担心自己会在她准备好之前就失控、做出什么坏事。

lines.en: : Probably not the best idea, Rin.
lines.zh: : 那大概不是什么好主意，Rin。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight10
: Then...teach me how to control myself better!
lines.zh: : 那么……教教我怎么更好地控制自己！

lines.en: : I don’t wanna mess things up, and I’m already one step closer to doing that by hiding my cutting from her.
lines.zh: : 我不想把事情搞砸，而我瞒着她自残的事，已经让我离搞砸更近了一步。

lines.en: : You’re asking {i}me{/i} how to...not have sex with girls?
lines.zh: : 你是想问{i}我{/i}怎么……不跟女孩子上床？

lines.en: : No, dude. I’m asking you how you always manage to hold yourself back.
lines.zh: : 不，老兄。我是问你，你是怎么做到每次都能忍住的。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight11
: The Chika thing {i}still{/i} surprises me.
lines.zh: : Chika 那件事{i}到现在都{/i}让我觉得不可思议。

lines.en: : Like...I’m not allowed to say this anymore because girlfriend-
lines.zh: : 就是……这种话我已经不能说了，因为我有女朋友了——

lines.en: : I won’t say anything. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我不会说出去的。别担心。

lines.en: : I know. I was gonna say it anyway because I trust you. But yeah, Chika is {i}so{/i} fucking hot.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我本来也要说，因为我信任你。不过是啊，Chika {i}真的{/i}他妈的辣。

lines.en: : I don’t know how you kept your hands to yourself. I really don’t.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道你是怎么管住自己那双手的。我是真不知道。

lines.en: : There was just someone else I liked more, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概只是因为当时我有更喜欢的人吧。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight12
: And, like...
lines.zh: : 而且，那个……

lines.en: : With me too.
lines.zh: : 对我也一样。

lines.en: : Not just with the delirious flashing stuff and the...random kiss we had after our date. But like, as a whole.
lines.zh: : 不只是那次神志不清的暴露，还有我们约会之后那个……即兴的吻。而是，所有的时刻。

lines.en: : Why didn’t you ever push for more?
lines.zh: : 你为什么从来不进一步？

lines.en: : You wanted to, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你想过，不是吗？

lines.en: : I might seem dense sometimes...but there have been a lot of moments where I’ve thought, “You know, I wouldn’t stop him if he did something right now.”
lines.zh: : 我有时候看起来是挺迟钝的……但有过很多次，我心里想的是“你知道吗，要是他现在做点什么，我不会拦他。”

lines.en: : But you never did.
lines.zh: : 可你从来没有。

lines.en: : I don’t want you to tell me {i}why{/i}, though. I want you to tell me {i}how{/i}.
lines.zh: : 不过我不要你告诉我{i}原因{/i}。我要你告诉我{i}怎么做{/i}。

lines.en: : How can I do that with Otoha to avoid ruining the best thing that’s happened to me since meeting you?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么做，才能对 Otoha 也这样，才能不毁掉自认识你以来发生在我身上最好的事？

lines.en: : Wow. Was I really the best thing up until that?
lines.zh: : 哇。在那之前，我真的是最好的那件事吗？

lines.en: scene rinhappynight13
: I wasn’t kidding when I said I loved you, you know.
lines.zh: : 我说我爱你的时候，可不是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : Not everyone would hold my wrist and call my roommate in the middle of the night to come take care of me.
lines.zh: : 不是每个人都愿意握着我的手腕，半夜打电话叫我的室友来照顾我。

lines.en: : Not everyone would volunteer to let me cry into them if things get terrible.
lines.zh: : 不是每个人都愿意主动让我在事情变得糟糕时抱着他哭。

lines.en: : And not everyone would come meet me in some sketchy part of Kumon-mi this late to just...talk about stuff.
lines.zh: : 也不是每个人都愿意为了……聊聊天，就这么晚跑到 Kumon-mi 这种可疑的地方来见我。

lines.en: : You are...{i}so{/i} important to me, Sensei. So important.
lines.zh: : 你对我……{i}太{/i}重要了，Sensei。太重要了。

lines.en: : Like...
lines.zh: : 就是……

lines.en: : Yeah.
: {i}So{/i} important...
lines.zh: : {i}太{/i}重要了……

lines.en: : Well, thanks. But I’m pretty sure this conversation was supposed to be about Otoha and not me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢谢。不过这场对话本来该是关于 Otoha，不是关于我的。

lines.en: : I’m still waiting on you to tell me how to not start groping her in the middle of casual conversation.
lines.zh: : 我还在等你告诉我，怎么才能不在闲聊到一半的时候就开始摸她。

lines.en: : I mean, that’s just kind of a common sense thing. Don’t grope {i}anyone{/i} in the middle of casual conversation.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，那就是常识了。别在闲聊到一半的时候摸{i}任何人{/i}。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight14
: Got it! Next tip, please.
lines.zh: : 懂了！下一条建议，请。

lines.en: : Masturbate frequently.
lines.zh: : 多自慰。

lines.en: : Like, before every time you two hang out.
lines.zh: : 就是，每次你们见面之前都来一次。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight15
: Oh my god. Is {i}that{/i} why you never made a move on me? Because you were too busy making moves on yourself?
lines.zh: : 我的天。{i}所以{/i}你当初没对我出手，是因为你忙着对自己出手？

lines.en: : Some secrets are meant to stay hidden, Rin.
lines.zh: : 有些秘密就该永远藏着，Rin。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I should be flattered, embarrassed, or grossed out.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己该觉得受宠若惊、尴尬，还是恶心。

lines.en: : You should be listening to my advice, because I’m about to give you the most important piece of the puzzle you’re trying to solve.
lines.zh: : 你该听我的建议，因为我正要给你拼图上最关键的那一块。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. I’m all ears. Hit me.
lines.zh: : 好好好，我洗耳恭听。说吧。

lines.en: : Just not in the arm because it still hurts.
lines.zh: : 就是别打胳膊，因为还疼呢。

lines.en: : The best way to hold yourself back is to just...do it.
lines.zh: : 忍住自己的最好办法，就是……去做。

lines.en: : That’s it? That’s your super awesome, foolproof advice? Just don’t do it?
lines.zh: : 就这样？这就是你那超厉害、万无一失的建议？就是别做？

lines.en: : Simple, right?
lines.zh: : 很简单吧？

lines.en: : So simple that it must be a joke.
lines.zh: : 简单到一定是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : Rin, have you stopped to think that maybe the reason you’re having such a hard time holding back is because that’s {i}all{/i} you’re thinking about when you’re with Otoha?
lines.zh: : Rin，你有没有想过，你之所以这么难忍住，会不会是因为你和 Otoha 在一起时{i}满脑子{/i}都在想这件事？

lines.en: : Just enjoy your time finally being happy or whatever.
lines.zh: : 就好好享受你终于得到的幸福什么的吧。

lines.en: : And, it sounds very weird saying this, but stop thinking of sex so much.
lines.zh: : 还有，虽然说起来很奇怪，但别再想那么多性了。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight16
: But she’s so hot! It’s hard!
lines.zh: : 可她太辣了！很难啊！

lines.en: : Well, the only alternative is just making {i}her{/i} want {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯，唯一的替代方案就是让{i}她{/i}也想要{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : But I’m dorky and weird and awkward. And if I take my clothes off, she’ll see my arm.
lines.zh: : 可我又呆又怪又笨拙。而且我要是脱了衣服，她就会看见我的胳膊。

lines.en: : Then just...put yourself into risky situations. Sleep in the same bed. Lock yourselves in a room together. Shower in the same stall.
lines.zh: : 那就……把自己放进有风险的情境里。睡在同一张床上。两个人锁在一个房间里。在同一个隔间里洗澡。

lines.en: : There are a bunch of opportunities open to you as two girls in an all-girls[school]. We make literally no effort to separate you all.
lines.zh: : 作为两个同在一所女子[school]里的女孩，你们有无数机会。学校根本不会花力气去把你们分开。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight17
: That was quite a few scenarios you managed to drum up off the top of your head, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你可真是张口就来了一堆场景啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : I spend a lot of time thinking about lesbians.
lines.zh: : 我花了很多时间思考女同性恋。

lines.en: : You sure you’re not just trying to spy on Otoha and me?
lines.zh: : 你确定你不是只想偷看我和 Otoha？

lines.en: : No. But if you happen to accidentally call me before the first time you two start experimenting on one another, I won’t mind.
lines.zh: : 不是。不过要是你们俩第一次开始互相“实验”之前，你不小心打给了我，我也不介意。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I like the idea of you listening to Otoha’s sexual moaning and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己喜不喜欢让你听 Otoha 性感的呻吟什么的这个主意。

lines.en: : Assuming of course that I’m actually able to make her feel anything and that I’m not the world’s worst bisexual.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是我真的能让她有感觉，而我不是世界上最差劲的双性恋。

lines.en: : Just keep the phone closer to you then. Just one voice will do.
lines.zh: : 那就把手机放得离你近一点。只留一个声音就够了。

lines.en: : Okay but what if I sound really weird? Like, not sexy at all. Just weird noises.
lines.zh: : 好的，可万一我听起来很怪呢？就是，一点都不性感，只是些奇怪的声音。

lines.en: : I can always hang up?
lines.zh: : 我随时可以挂电话？

lines.en: scene rinhappynight18
: Solid plan. Thanks, homie.
lines.zh: : 靠谱的计划。谢了，兄弟。

lines.en: : Will keep it in mind when I try and inevitably fail at making Otoha want to do stuff.
lines.zh: : 我会记在心里——在我试着让 Otoha 想做点什么、并且不可避免地失败的时候。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight19
: Oh! Speaking of which, that’s probably her.
lines.zh: : 哦！说起来，那大概就是她。

lines.en: : We send each other goodnight texts because we’re dating.
lines.zh: : 我们在交往，所以会互道晚安短信。

lines.en: : Have I mentioned yet that Otoha and I are dating?
lines.zh: : 我提过了吗，Otoha 和我在交往？

lines.en: : I’ll consider it a real relationship the moment one of you two gets the other to orgasm.
lines.zh: : 等你们中有一个让另一个高潮的那一刻，我就把它当成一段真正的关系。

lines.en: scene rinhappynight20
: Like, physically? Because...you know...
lines.zh: : 你是说身体上的？因为……你知道的……

lines.en: : If fantasies are involved and stuff, it’s prooooooobably safe to assume it’s already a real relationship based on that criteria.
lines.zh: : 如果幻想也算的话，那按这个标准，大概已经可以安全地断定这是一段真正的关系了。

lines.en: : Obviously not counting that.
lines.zh: : 那个当然不算。

lines.en: : You sure? Cause I’m not confirming anything, but it’s prooooooooobably happened more than once. By like...somewhere in the double digits.
lines.zh: : 你确定？因为我什么都没在确认，不过它大概已经发生过不止一次了。大概……两位数那么多次。

lines.en: : Or triple.
lines.zh: : 或者三位数。

lines.en: : She’s so hot.
lines.zh: : 她太辣了。

lines.en: : Just text her back, Rin.
lines.zh: : 快回她短信吧，Rin。

lines.en: scene black
Instead of just texting her, Rin decides to call Otoha and say goodnight.
lines.zh: Rin 没有只回短信，而是决定给 Otoha 打电话说晚安。

lines.en: They continue to chat for a few moments, and it ultimately leads to Rin admitting that she went out for a late night walk to “get her mind off of stuff.”
lines.zh: 她们又聊了一会儿，最后 Rin 承认自己深夜出去散步是“为了不去想那些事”。

lines.en: Of course, she never admits that she met up with me. And I don’t blame her for that.
lines.zh: 当然，她没有承认是来见我的。我也不怪她。

lines.en: Otoha knows that Rin and I have kissed. And she doesn’t seem to have fully warmed up to me just yet in general...so keeping it secret is probably for the best.
lines.zh: Otoha 知道我和 Rin 接过吻。而且她似乎总体上还没完全对我热络起来……所以保密大概是最好的选择。

lines.en: The call ends shortly after and, without really exchanging any words about it, Rin and I appear to silently and mutually agree that it’s time to head back.
lines.zh: 电话很快就结束了，之后我们几乎没说什么，就似乎心照不宣地同意该回去了。

lines.en: Along the way, we talk about a number of other things.
lines.zh: 一路上，我们又聊了很多别的事。

lines.en: I don’t remember any of them.
lines.zh: 我一句都不记得了。

lines.en: I wound up, once again, getting too distracted by the dramatic contrast between her appearance and her actions.
lines.zh: 我再一次被她外表与举止之间那种强烈的反差分散了注意力。

lines.en: When we make it back to the dorm, she tells me she loves me again.
lines.zh: 回到宿舍时，她又对我说了一次她爱我。

lines.en: I nod and head home.
lines.zh: 我点了点头，回家去了。
